snippet.title: Deadly Days: Roadtrip - 1.0 Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
Release date confirmed: 29. October 2026 - The roadtrip launches into 1.0 on Steam and ventures on to Xbox, Windows PC and PlayStation 5!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3026450/Deadly_Days_Roadtrip/
